description:
Return a Work Order Contract.

### Special notes (Tiers)

The visibility of Change Order Packages, Potential Change Orders & Change Order Requests
depends on the number of tiers defined in the Work Order Contract as follows:

1-tier: Change Order Packages

2-tier: Change Order Packages, Potential Change Orders

3-tier: Change Order Packages, Change Order Requests, Potential Change Orders

schema.description: Full representation of a work order contract (subcontractor commitment).

accounting_method.description: Whether line items on this contract are tracked by lump-sum amount or by quantity times unit cost.

actual_completion_date.description: Date the contracted work was actually completed.

approval_letter_date.description: Date on the contract's approval letter.

approved_change_orders.description: Total value of approved change orders on this contract, as a decimal string.

url.description: Download URL for the attached file.

filename.description: Original name of the attached file.

change_order_packages.description: Change order packages associated with the contract.

id.description: Unique identifier for the change order package.

contract_id.description: ID of the work order contract this package belongs to.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the package was created, in ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the package was soft-deleted, in ISO 8601 format. Null when active.

due_date.description: Date the change order package is due.

invoiced_date.description: Date the change order package was invoiced.

origin_data.description: Free-form data set by an external system for this package.

origin_id.description: Identifier assigned by an external system for this package.

paid_date.description: Date the change order package was paid.

reviewed_at.description: Timestamp when the package was reviewed, in ISO 8601 format.

title.description: Title of the change order package.

status.description: Current state of the change order package.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the package was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

change_order_requests.description: Change order requests associated with the contract, grouped by change order package.

contract_date.description: Effective date of the contract agreement.

contract_start_date.description: Date the contracted work is scheduled to start.

contract_estimated_completion_date.description: Estimated date the contracted work will be completed.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the contract was created, in ISO 8601 format.

created_by_id.description: ID of the user who created the Contract

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the contract was soft-deleted, in ISO 8601 format. Null for active contracts.

description.description: Rich-text description of the contract scope.

draft_change_orders_amount.description: Combined value of all draft change orders, as a decimal string.

exclusions.description: Rich-text list of work explicitly excluded from the contract scope.

executed.description: Whether the contract has been fully executed (signed by all parties).

execution_date.description: Date the contract was executed (signed by all parties).

grand_total.description: Total contract value including all line items and markup, as a decimal string.

id.description: Unique identifier for the work order contract. Use as the {id} path parameter for GET/PATCH/DELETE /rest/v1.0/work_order_contracts/{id}.

inclusions.description: Rich-text list of work explicitly included in the contract scope.

invoice_contacts.description: Contacts designated as points of contact for subcontractor invoices on this contract.

business_phone.description: Business phone number of the contact.

business_phone_extension.description: Business phone extension of the contact.

fax_number.description: Fax number of the contact. Null if not set.

job_title.description: Job title of the contact. Null if not set.

login_information_id.description: ID of the user's login information record, if the contact is a Procore user.

mobile_phone.description: Mobile phone number of the contact.

vendor_name.description: Name of the vendor company the contact belongs to.

issued_on_date.description: Date the contract was issued to the vendor.

letter_of_intent_date.description: Date on the contract's letter of intent.

line_items.description: Schedule of values line items on the contract.

id.description: Unique identifier for the line item.

amount.description: Amount for the line item, as a decimal string.

company.description: Company the line item is associated with.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the line item was created, in ISO 8601 format.

extended_type.description: Whether the line item amount is entered manually or calculated from quantity and unit cost.

holder.description: Record that owns this line item.

line_item_type.description: Cost type classification for the line item.

origin_data.description: Free-form data set by an external system for this line item. Null when created in Procore.

origin_id.description: Identifier assigned by an external system for this line item. Null when created in Procore.

position.description: Ordering position of the line item within the contract.

project.description: Project the line item belongs to.

tax_code_id.description: ID of the tax code applied to the line item.

total_amount.description: Total amount for the line item, as a decimal string.

extended_amount.description: Extended amount (quantity times unit cost) for the line item.

unit_cost.description: Cost per unit for the line item.

uom.description: Unit of measure for the line item quantity.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the line item was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

change_event_line_item.description: Change event line item linked to this contract line item.

number.description: Human-readable contract number. Uniqueness is only enforced when `enforce_number_uniqueness` is provided.

origin_data.description: Free-form data set by an external/integrating system when the contract originated outside Procore.

origin_code.description: Code set by an external/integrating system identifying the contract's origin.

origin_id.description: Identifier assigned by the external system that created this contract. Null for contracts created in Procore.

amount.description: Payment amount, as a decimal string.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the payment was created, in ISO 8601 format.

draw_request_number.description: Payment number of a Draw Request, Owner Invoice, or Subcontractor Invoice

invoice_number.description: Invoice number associated with the payment.

origin_id.description: Identifier assigned by an external system for this payment.

origin_data.description: Free-form data set by an external system for this payment.

pending_change_orders.description: Combined value of pending and revised change orders, as a decimal string.

pending_revised_contract.description: Revised contract amount including pending and revised change orders, as a decimal string.

percentage_paid.description: Percentage of the contract value that has been paid, as a string.

potential_change_orders.description: Work Order Contract potential change orders

id.description: Unique identifier for the potential change order.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the potential change order was created, in ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the potential change order was soft-deleted, in ISO 8601 format. Null when active.

due_date.description: Date the potential change order is due.

invoiced_date.description: Date the potential change order was invoiced.

paid_date.description: Date the potential change order was paid.

reviewed_at.description: Timestamp when the potential change order was reviewed, in ISO 8601 format.

title.description: Title of the potential change order.

status.description: Current state of the potential change order.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the potential change order was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

private.description: If true, visible to admins and whitelisted accessors; otherwise visible to those with read only access.

remaining_balance_outstanding.description: Outstanding balance remaining to be paid on the contract, as a decimal string.

requisitions_are_enabled.description: If true, Requisitions (Subcontractor Invoice) are enabled on the Commitment Contract

retainage_percent.description: Default retainage percentage withheld on billings, as a string.

returned_date.description: Date the signed contract was returned by the vendor.

revised_contract.description: Contract value including approved change orders, as a decimal string.

signed_contract_received_date.description: Date the signed contract was received.

show_line_items_to_non_admins.description: If true and the contract is private, non admins with access to the contract will be able to view the SOV items

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the work order contract.

title.description: Title of the work order contract.

total_draw_requests_amount.description: Combined amount of all draw requests on the contract, as a decimal string.

total_payments.description: Combined amount of all payments issued on the contract, as a decimal string.

total_requisitions_amount.description: Combined amount of all requisitions (sub invoices) on the contract, as a decimal string.

id.description: Unique identifier for the vendor company in the project directory.

origin_data.description: Free-form data set by an external system for this vendor.

origin_id.description: Identifier assigned by an external system for this vendor.
